title: Final Expression for H
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the magnetic field H in terms of E, K, n, and mu.

title: Final Expression for n
description: Essential Criteria: The student must derive and present the correct expression for the index of refraction n in terms of omega, epsilon, mu, and sigma.

title: Use of Maxwell's Equations
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply Maxwell's equations relevant to the problem, including the definitions of D, B, and J.

title: Wave Equation Derivation
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive the wave equation for E correctly, showing the relationship between E, mu, epsilon, and sigma.

title: Vector Relationships
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly identify the relationships between the vectors E, K, and H, including the orthogonality conditions.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign mistakes in the derivation of the wave equation and expressions for H and n.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout the derivation and final expressions.

title: Mathematical Clarity
description: Optional Criteria: The student should present calculations clearly, showing all steps and justifications for transformations used.

title: Limiting Cases
description: Optional Criteria: The student may discuss limiting cases or special scenarios that could simplify the expressions derived.
